chapter: Recollections of Trent's band and its influence
title: Offers from Chick Webb and which bands made money
summary: Mosley turned down Chick Webb because the band did not pay; only a few bands made money.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I was surprised that you wouldn't have gotten with somebody like Chick Webb or one of those bands.
I didn't particularly want to go with a band like Chick's. They weren't making any money. They weren't making any money at all and I had been accustomed to making money.
I had an offer to go with Teddy--I don't remember getting an offer to go with Chick Webb, but I do know that one of the offers I got didn't interest me at all.
Wait a minute--I did get an offer from Chick Webb; that's when I said I wasn't thinking about leaving Trent's band.
Slats Paris was working with Chick, maybe Slats told him about you.

Actually when you think about it, the only bands that were making money were Cab and Duke. Cab, Duke and Claude were the only three bands that were making any money. Louis, of course, was making money.
